summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package's declared purpose is a React JSON-render catalog, but package.json declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, string-lookup tables) and downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13 to a temp directory, extracts and chmods it, then invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled/obfuscated JavaScript payload (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-named identifiers, large string-array with rotator function) whose behavior is opaque without executing it under Bun; its deceptive filename and content do not correspond to any functionality of a React UI catalog library. The use of an alternate language runtime to execute the payload evades Node-based tooling and code review; the obfuscation of both the setup script and the payload has no legitimate purpose for an install shim.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
